WITH team_stats AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
),
team_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_team_avg_win_rate
    FROM team_stats
)
SELECT
    ts.team_id,
    ts.avg_win_rate,
    ts.record_count,
    ts.avg_win_rate - tm.mean_team_avg_win_rate AS difference_from_mean
FROM team_stats AS ts
CROSS JOIN team_mean AS tm
WHERE tm.mean_team_avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
